reply.text: This one is about caffeine amounts, and I don't give numbers for that, so I won't pick a figure for you. What I can say as a coach: pre-workout energy drinks can make some people jittery, wired, or unable to sleep, and that hurts a session as much as it helps. If you're having three before every session, that's worth a conversation with a doctor or dietitian about what's right for you. Meanwhile, notice how you sleep and how your lifts feel on the days you have them versus the days you don't. What are you lifting this week?
